entries.label: FHSA annual contribution limit
entries.notes: Room starts only when the account is opened (unlike TFSA back-dating to 18). One account per person at a time.

entries.label: FHSA unused-room carry-forward
entries.notes: Annual cap is $8,000 of new room, but unused room carries forward; max deductible in one year = $8,000 (new) + $8,000 (carried) = $16,000.

entries.label: FHSA maximum lifespan
entries.notes: Close by Dec 31 of the 15th year after opening, or of the year you turn 71, whichever is earlier.
entries.value: Closes 15 years after opening or at age 71 (whichever first); unused amounts roll to RRSP tax-free

entries.label: FHSA excess-contribution tax
entries.notes: No $2,000 buffer (unlike RRSP). RC728 filing for excess FHSA amounts.

entries.label: FHSA qualifying withdrawal conditions
entries.notes: 90-day rule: you must not have lived in an owner-occupied home in the current year or the previous 4 years (same first-time-buyer test as HBP).
entries.value: Tax-free for a qualifying first home purchase; must be Canadian resident, first-time buyer, written agreement to buy/build within 30 days of withdrawal, and occupy within 1 year

entries.label: Home Buyers' Plan withdrawal limit per person
entries.notes: Raised from $35,000 (Apr 16, 2024 federal budget). Couples stack two plans.

rejected.reason: Stale - raised to $60,000 April 16, 2024. Seen on mortgagecapitalinvestment.com (Feb 2026 page).

entries.label: HBP couple stacking
entries.notes: Each spouse must have $60,000 of RRSP room available.

entries.label: HBP standard repayment period
entries.notes: Example: $60,000 withdrawn -> $4,000/yr minimum ($60,000 / 15). Minimum annual repayment = balance / years remaining.

entries.label: HBP repayment start
entries.notes: RESOLVED 2026-09-30: the 5-year grace is REAL and legislated (Budget 2024) but applies ONLY to first withdrawals made Jan 1, 2022-Dec 31, 2025. Claims of a 2026-2028 extension window are unconfirmed and NOT encoded. Shortfall gets added to taxable income for the year.
entries.value: Repayments start the 2nd calendar year after withdrawal; designate repayments on Schedule 7

entries.label: HBP key rules
entries.notes: Buy/build by Oct 1 of the year after withdrawal (e.g. 2026 withdrawal -> by Oct 1, 2027, from promo-expiry calendar). Flowchart deliberately excluded the disputed 2026-2028 grace period (see notes).
entries.value: First-time buyer test (no owner-occupied home in current + previous 4 years); buy/build by Oct 1 of the year after withdrawal; 90-day RRSP holding rule; T1036 filed within 1 year of withdrawal

entries.label: FHSA + HBP stacking for couples
entries.notes: Two people: $40,000 x 2 FHSA + $60,000 x 2 HBP = $200,000 of tax-assisted down payment. A person can use both plans if FHSA funds cannot cover everything.
entries.source_note: CRA FHSA page + fhsa-vs-hbp flowchart build note (2026-09-29).

entries.label: Home Buyers' Amount federal credit
entries.notes: Bill C-4 cut the lowest federal bracket to 14.5% for 2025 and 14% from 2026: $10,000 x 14% = $1,400 for 2026. The widely repeated $1,500 is the old 15% calculation. CRA publishes the $10,000 claim amount; the credit figure is arithmetic, not a quoted CRA number.
entries.source_note: CRA line 31270 page for the $10,000 amount; 14% lowest-bracket rate for 2026 corroborated by TurboTax and ghumans.ca (verified 2026-09-30).

entries.label: HBP 5-year repayment grace (2022-2025 withdrawals)
entries.source_note: Budget 2024 announcement coverage (Apr 2024): 2022-2025 withdrawals get 5-year grace; mechanics corroborated by MoneySense and thefinancialcollective.ca (verified 2026-09-30).
entries.notes: Temporary relief: 15-year repayment period starts in the 5th year after the withdrawal year (instead of the 2nd) for first withdrawals in 2022-2025. Repayment period stays 15 years; only the start moves. See hbp.repayment_grace_2026_2028 for the extension window.

entries.label: HBP 5-year repayment grace extension (2026-2028 withdrawals)
entries.source_note: CRA main HBP page (modified 2026-02-17), read 2026-10-02: 'The Home Buyers\' Plan (HBP) temporary repayment relief has been extended for individuals making a first HBP withdrawal between January 1, 2026, and December 31, 2028.' Note: CRA's repayment detail sub-page (modified 2026-01-20) still shows only the 2022-2025 window.
entries.notes: Extension of the Budget 2024 relief: 15-year repayment period starts in the 5th year after the withdrawal year for first withdrawals in 2026-2028. Withdrawals after Dec 31, 2028: CRA pages do not state the rule explicitly; standard 2nd-year schedule presumably resumes.
